name: Beef in tamarind
summary: Thin beef dipped at the table into a sweet-sour tamarind sauce simmering on a hot pan.
origin: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 says bò nhúng me had appeared in Buon Ma Thuot in the few years before that article.
howToEat: Brush butter on the pan, add the tamarind sauce and onion, and wait for a gentle boil before dipping the beef and vegetables. Tip everything in at once and the beef turns tough and loses its smell.
seoTitle: Bo nhung me in Buon Ma Thuot — beef in tamarind
seoDescription: Thin beef dipped into sweet-sour tamarind on a hot buttered pan, on Le Thanh Tong.
